'''Elite Raider''' is a [[Common enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|An elite Landbreaker melee combatant enhanced by fumes known as hazefyre. This particular LB has better gear, strength, and battle skills.}}

==Overview==
[[Bonekrusher Raider]]s enhanced by hazefyre, Elite Raiders have similar appearance with their counterpart, but it doesn't make them more of a threat; Their only attack is an upward swing or a downward swing with their sword, which deals Physical damage.
